headline: Trane Technologies (TT) Faces Fresh Valuation Questions After Supply Chain Chief Exit
summary: Executive change at Trane Technologies sets the stage for fresh investor scrutiny Trane Technologies (TT) recently announced that Senior Vice President and Chief Global Integrated Supply Chain Officer Mingxiao Guo will leave the company on August 1, 2026, under a Separation Agreement.
